idea-plugin.name: epher
idea-plugin.description:
The epher calculator language in your JetBrains IDE: syntax highlighting with bracket matching, a diagnostic for every broken statement, the answer rendered inline next to every statement that produces one, hover with canonical signatures, completion for the catalog and your own names, and the shared snippets.

The plugin is a thin shell (ADR-0066): all understanding lives in the shared epher-lsp language server, which the plugin downloads on first use and caches. Works in the commercial JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, PyCharm Professional, WebStorm, GoLand, and the rest) from 2024.2 on; the platform's LSP client does not ship in Community builds. Marketplace publication comes later: install this build from disk.
